_speed: Rail previews are encoded at 4x the rendered pace (ffmpeg setpts=PTS/4,fps=25). A full narrative runs over a minute, which is far longer than anyone watches a carousel slide; 4x turns it into a ~17s loop that reads as an animation at a glance. The speed-up is baked into the file rather than applied with playbackRate, so the download is smaller and `duration` below stays honest.
